Nina: Free 27\" ultra-wide monitor (LG) 16:9? (ish) moving next week, light bezel, works great, no dead pixels. Pick up from Mission office. Pics: https://imgur.com/a/placeholder
Samir: Interested! What resolution is it and does it include the stand?
Nina: 2560x1080, stand included but it's a bit wobbly (I usually mount it). HDMI + DP cables included.
Theo: Can someone help me carry it downstairs? Have a compact car so might need a hand.
facilities-bot: Heads up: please pre-register at reception for pickups. Weekend pickup allowed if security is notified.
Samir: I can pick it up Sat 11am and can bring a friend to help with transport. Which conference room?
Nina: I'll leave it in Greenroom (3rd floor) labeled \"HOLD - SAMIR\". If plans change I'll update here.
Theo: If Samir can't make it, I'll take it Sun afternoon.
Samir: DM'd Nina to confirm. Leaving a note here so others know.
Nina: Confirmed with Samir. Thanks! If something falls through I'll post back.
Theo: Thanks for not tossing it. Good monitor for side projects. :slightly_smiling_face:
